newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CorpGro buys hardware chain for 28 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: CorpGro buys hardware chain for 28 mln rand.

text.p: South African industrial holding company, CorpGro Ltd, on Thursday said it had bought a chain of hardware companies for 28.2 million rand.

It said in a statement it had bought the entire business of B&B Distributors Ltd, based in the Gauteng province, B&B Hardward Distributors (Natal) and 65 percent of its business in the Cape province, with effect from September 1.
The purchase price was expected to be financed by a combination of the issue of shares to vendors, and the placing of further shares with third parties on behalf of the vendors.
Had the B&B acquisitions been effective throughout the previous financial year, pro-forma earnings would have increased by 39 percent to 1.78 cents, CorpGro said.

Jeff Liebesmann, CorpGro's chief executive said the purchase was in line with the company's philosophy of investing in partnerships with businesses which offer prospects of long-term sustainable growth in niche business sectors.
CorpGro, formerly South East Rand Gold Holdings Ltd, earlier this week finalised the acquisition of Matador Refrigeration (Pty) Ltd.
